title: ChangeFlowVersionRequest
description: Request object for change flow version of a deployment.

environmentCrn.description: The CRN of an environment to execute the command.

deploymentCrn.description: The crn of the deployment being updated.

parameterGroups.description: The list of flow parameter groups.

strategy.description: The strategy to use during change flow version.

waitForFlowToStopInMinutes.description: The max time in minutes to wait for the flow to process data.

ignoreCustomNarConfigurationCheck.description: When specified, ignore the check to validate if deployment has custom NARs configured when the flow definition contains custom components.

ignoreCustomPythonConfigurationCheck.description: When specified, ignore the check to validate if deployment has custom Python configured when the flow definition contains custom Python processors.

ignoreDeploymentInboundConfigurationChec.description: When specified, ignore the check to validate if deployment has inbound connection configured for all listen components.

deploymentRequestCrn.description: The CRN of the deployment request.

assetUpdateRequestCrn.description: The CRN of the asset update request. Required when updating assets of an existing deployment.

AlertFrequencyUnit.description: The alert frequency unit to use in KPI tolerances and metrics

id.description: The id of the frequency unit

label.description: The user-friendly label of the frequency unit

AssetReference.description: A reference to an asset used in a flow parameter

environmentProvided.description: Whether or not the asset is provided automatically by the environment. If true, the asset cannot removed or replaced.

ConfiguredAlert.description: An alert configuration that specifies a configured frequency with lower and/or upper thresholds

thresholdMoreThan.description: The optional moreThan threshold that should trigger an alert; at least one of thresholdMoreThan and thresholdLessThan is required

thresholdLessThan.description: The optional lessThan threshold that should trigger an alert

frequencyTolerance.description: The configured alert frequency tolerance for the KPI

ConfiguredAlertFrequencyTolerance.description: An alert configuration frequency tolerance for measuring an amount of time and unit for alert triggering

unit.description: The unit of time controlling how long a metric value can persist outside its boundaries before an alert is generated

value.description: The amount of time, associated with the given unit, a metric value can persist outside its boundaries before an alert is generated

ConfiguredAlertThreshold.description: A configured alert threshold to pair together a statistical unit and value

unitId.description: The identifier of the alert threshold unit to associate with the given threshold value

value.description: The threshold value whose triggering causes an alert

ConfiguredKpi.description: An instantiated KPI specifying a metric on which to alert

metricId.description: The id of the associated metric

id.description: The id of the KPI; used only when viewing and editing existing KPIs

metricComponentType.description: The component type of the associated metric

alert.description: The alert specification for the associated metric

componentId.description: The optional process group ID, processor ID, or connection ID. This is a composite ID containing a chain of process group IDs representing the component's full ancestry

sensitive.description: Whether or not the parameter value is sensitive

type.description: The type of parameter. Possibly TEXT, FILE, FILES

valueSet.description: Indicates if the value of this parameter is set (i.e. not null)

sourceParameterGroupId.description: The ID of the shared parameter group where the value should come from.

name.description: The name of the parameter group

inheritedParameterGroups.description: The names and versions of the inherited parameter groups

otherName.description: The other name that can be used to reference this group in a flow. This is used when multiple flows with same parameter group are deployed in to same NiFi cluster.

VersionedParameterGroupReference.description: A reference to a specific version of a shared parameter group

groupId.description: The ID of the parameter group

version.description: The version of the parameter group. Empty or null means the latest version.
